items.title: 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of addiction, tolerance and withdrawal (PDF 47-48).

blocks.text: Psychoactive drugs ka ghalat istemal (abuse) aksar dependence (inhisar) tak le jata hai. Dependence woh halat hai jis mein insan kaam kaaj ke liye jismani ya jazbati taur par kisi drug par munhasir ho jata hai. Dependence aksar addiction (lat) ban jati hai. Drug addiction ka matlab hai drug ki be-qaboo talab aur us ke bure asraat ke bawajood us ka istemal, jo ek bimari hai.

Jab insan musalsal drug istemal karta rehta hai to jism us ka aadi (adaptive) ho jata hai aur us ke asar ke liye kam hassas ho jata hai. Is halat ko drug tolerance kehte hain. Tolerance ke baad wahi asar hasil karne ke liye zyada khuraak (doses) chahiye hoti hai. Is se lat aur barh jati hai.

Jab aadi log nasha-awar (addictive) drug lena chhor dete hain to unhein withdrawal symptoms (chhorne ki alamaat) hoti hain. In mein ulti, sar dard, be-khwabi (insomnia), saans ki mushkil, depression, zehni be-qarari aur dauray (seizures) shamil ho sakte hain.
